notes.title: New mission: 'Doubles'
notes.content: We are proudly presenting a brand new Brick Breaker Bunch mission '[b]Doubles[/b]', designed especially for local co-op! Challenge yourself and your friends and complete these eight new double-decker stages.

notes.title: Mouse support added!
notes.content: Brick Breaker Bunch can be now played with mouse! Configure mouse to desired bat from settings menu.

notes.title: Mouse support added!
notes.content: Brick Breaker Bunch can be now played with mouse! Configure mouse to desired pad from [b]settings[/b] menu.
